limitations: L1 is defined but has no published artifacts.
Training used drop_last=True: 499968/500000 images per CNN epoch.
Hardware varies: RTX A6000, A100 and A100 MIG; raw timings do not isolate optimizer speed.
Dependencies are minimum versions; the original exact environment is not published.
Validation selects checkpoints and is not an independent test.
Summary mejor_epoca is argmax(top1), while saved weights use min_delta; use checkpoint selection reconstructed from history.
The rounded L1 control has 120000 images, versus 120474 in long-tail.
A single seed supports descriptive recipe comparisons, not significance claims.
